offering_description.value: Mirion designs and manufactures radiation detection, monitoring and measurement equipment for nuclear operators, government agencies and research laboratories. It supplies radiation therapy quality assurance systems and nuclear medicine instruments to healthcare providers, and provides occupational dosimetry through laboratory processing and dose reporting.

primary_products.value: radiation detectors and spectrometers; nuclear plant instrumentation and monitoring systems; radiation therapy quality assurance hardware and software; nuclear medicine instruments; personal dosimeters

primary_services.value: occupational dose monitoring and reporting; instrument calibration and repair; nuclear instrumentation engineering and field services

customer_segment.value: B2B: nuclear utilities, nuclear facility contractors, hospitals, cancer centers, nuclear pharmacies and industrial employers; B2G: defense and homeland security agencies, government research laboratories and public hospitals

end_markets.value: nuclear power and decommissioning; healthcare; defense and homeland security; scientific research; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: radiation instruments, plant monitoring equipment, medical quality assurance systems and dosimeters; service fees: recurring occupational dose monitoring, calibration, repair and field support; project or contract: engineered instrumentation and monitoring systems for nuclear facilities
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: integrates detectors, sensors and electronics into instruments for nuclear operators, hospitals and laboratories; service provider: processes dosimeter readings and reports worker exposure to employers, and calibrates customer instruments; software / platform: turns measurement data into quality assurance and dose reports for clinical teams and radiation safety staff
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: nuclear instrumentation, radiation detection and protection, radiation therapy quality assurance, nuclear medicine and occupational dosimetry

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving nuclear utilities, healthcare institutions, laboratories and government agencies; distributors / dealers: regional distributors of radiation instruments and medical quality assurance equipment

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA medical device requirements for applicable products and nuclear quality assurance requirements for safety-related equipment

notes: The current scope of nuclear plant field services is uncertain.
